title: upgradescope JSON report, schemaVersion 1
description: What `upgradescope scan --output json` and `--write-baseline` write. Within schemaVersion 1 fields are only added, never renamed, removed, retyped or given a new meaning, so the schema allows unknown fields: ignore them. internal/cli/docs_test.go validates real scan output against this file and fails on a field it does not list.

toolVersion.description: The binary that wrote the report. Informational, no compatibility meaning.

filesBase.description: --files only: the scanned directory relative to the working directory ("" = the working directory), which object file paths are relative to.

clusterId.description: The kube-system namespace UID, or "files" for a --files scan.

kbVersion.description: The knowledge base the report was judged with.

score.description: max(0, 100 - min(75, 25 x blockers) - min(20, 5 x warnings)); suppressed findings excluded.

ready.description: verdict == ready. Kept for v0.1 readers; prefer verdict.

verdict.description: blocked: a blocker. unknown: no blocker, but a required check was not assessed. ready: neither.

teams.description: Per-team scores; findings with no team are under "unattributed". Present when there are findings.

key.description: Stable, count-free identity: category/discriminator. Baselines and notifications match on it.

baselineState.description: With --baseline: unchanged (the baseline had it) or new.

source.description: What suppressed it: the config file, annotation, or spec.ignore.

expires.description: YYYY-MM-DD, as the rule gave it.

file.description: Manifest path, slash-separated, relative to filesBase.

line.description: 1-based line of the object's apiVersion key.

renderedFrom.description: The Helm template the object was rendered from (# Source: comment).

manager.description: Live objects: the field manager that wrote it through the flagged API, or kubectl last-applied.

required.description: The gap makes the verdict unknown.
